name: kinsy
description: A finished, editable PowerPoint deck from a brief and your documents, from the terminal. Adds the kinsy skill: when to use the Kinsy CLI, how to brief it, how to hand the .pptx back.

interface.shortDescription: Finished, editable PowerPoint decks from a brief and your documents.
interface.longDescription: Kinsy turns a brief and your source documents into a native PowerPoint file: real text boxes, tables and charts, embedded fonts and a slide master, with unsupported numbers flagged. This plugin adds the kinsy skill, which teaches an agent to build a deck with the Kinsy CLI and hand back the .pptx and a link to review and edit it. Keys spend the same credits as the web app; new accounts start with free credits.
